title: Whale eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Whale body -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="58" rx="34" ry="22" fill="#3A7BD5"/>
  <!-- Whale belly -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="68" rx="24" ry="12" fill="#A8D8F0"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M78 58 Q90 48 92 38 Q84 44 80 52 Q82 58 78 62 Z" fill="#2A5FA8"/>
  <path d="M78 58 Q90 68 92 78 Q84 72 80 64 Q82 58 78 54 Z" fill="#2A5FA8"/>

  <circle cx="27" cy="52" r="3" fill="#1B2A4A"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M18 62 Q24 68 32 64" stroke="#1B2A4A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <path d="M14 60 Q8 66 14 72 Q22 76 30 70 Q22 66 14 60 Z" fill="#C03050"/>

  <circle cx="18" cy="65" r="1.3" fill="#5A2A00"/>

  <ellipse cx="36" cy="62" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF9BB0" opacity="0.8"/>

  <path d="M40 36 Q38 28 40 22" stroke="#7FE0FF" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 34 Q50 26 50 20" stroke="#7FE0FF" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 36 Q62 28 60 22" stroke="#7FE0FF" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="18" r="2.5" fill="#BFF3FF"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="2.5" fill="#BFF3FF"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="18" r="2.5" fill="#BFF3FF"/>
  <!-- Fin -->
  <path d="M42 76 Q46 88 54 88 Q48 82 46 76 Z" fill="#2A5FA8"/>
</svg>
